name: AppVault
subtitle: AppVault and official IPA download tools
description: Prepare a per-app stock iOS decryption helper from a licensed IPA, sign/install it with payload-preserving EmberSign, then export from the helper. Requires the owning Apple Account and Developer Mode. Includes separate rootless installed-app export. Real-device helper signing/decryption remains unverified.

apps.name: DLiPA
apps.subtitle: App Store IPA downloader
apps.localizedDescription: Official, unmodified DLiPA by AhmedBafkir. Download and share App Store apps as IPA files using your Apple Account; supports available older versions. This downloads packages from Apple, not the installed binary from your phone. Apple account authorization and version availability apply. Authentication and downloads on iOS 27.0.1 have not been tested by AppVault's maintainer.
